description.value: A large year-round private RV park on 20 wooded acres just north of Courtenay, with 10 quiet tent-only sites and a direct trail into Seal Bay Nature Park; primarily an RV facility with coin showers and WiFi, so expect a suburban campground feel.

address.value: 1901 Larch Road, Courtenay, BC, Canada V9J 1X7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides rich detail. The contact page confirms the address (1901 Larch Road, Courtenay, BC V9J 1X7) and phone ((250) 339-1837) not present in OSM tags. Amenities are clearly listed across multiple subpages: coin-operated showers and laundry, WiFi, a 2,500 sq ft covered Picnic Pavilion, 10 tent-only wilderness sites, electrical hookups at all RV sites, and a press article mentioning nearby grocery retail (Costco, Thrifty's Food). A minor concern is inconsistency between 140 and 150 sites cited in different parts of the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both sourced from website only so contact_confirmed is null for those fields.
Site count is inconsistent across website pages — 140 sites cited in most places but 150 mentioned on the front page and facilities page; likely a content update inconsistency.
Ten tent sites is a small tent-camping inventory relative to the 140+ RV sites; primarily an RV park.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate year-round campground with dedicated tent-only sites, strong amenity set (showers, laundry, covered shelter, WiFi), and direct trail access to a regional park — a solid stop for touring cyclists in the Comox Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Trail directly into Seal Bay Nature Park noted as an on-site activity — relevant for cyclists wanting to explore the adjacent regional park on foot.

wow_evidence: coin-operated showers and laundry, WiFi, a 2,500 sq ft covered Picnic Pavilion, 10 tent-only wilderness sites
